summary: FTI Consulting filed an 8-K disclosing its annual shareholder meeting results (routine) and a board authorization to repurchase an additional $370 million of common stock under its existing Stock Repurchase Program. The program has cumulative authorizations of $2.6 billion, with 19,104,867 shares repurchased through June 2, 2026. No specific price, premium, or timeline is given; the authorization expands available capacity. The filing is a routine capital-return disclosure, not a full self-tender or other special situation. Watch for future repurchase pace and program exhaustion.
